title: beta-Sitosterol ameliorates metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis by targeting the RAC1/mTOR/TFEB axis thus activating lipophagy-lysosomal pathway.
authors: Wang, Yang; Sun, Yi; Wang, Chang-Yuan; Cao, Min; Hao, Ru; Wang, Shan; Sun, Hui-Jun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究β-谷甾醇通过RAC1/mTOR/TFEB轴激活脂噬-溶酶体通路治疗代谢相关脂肪性肝炎，核心为小分子药物机制与疾病治疗，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH), an inflammatory subtype of metabolic dysfunction-associated fatty liver disease (MAFLD), drives hepatic dysfunction and poses a significant health burden. Lipophagy dysfunction disrupts lipid droplet degradation and induces lysosomal damage, which is closely linked to MASH progression; thus, targeting lipophagy-lysosomal activation has emerged as a promising therapeutic strategy for the therapy of MASH. beta-Sitosterol (beta-SIT) derived from Polygonum hydropiper L. is structurally similar to cholesterol, and exhibits neuroprotective, antidiabetic and anti-obesity bioactivities. In this study, we explored the therapeutic potential of beta-SIT for MASH. The mouse models of MASH were established by feeding a choline-deficient, L-amino acid-defined high-fat diet (CDAHFD) for 10 weeks, or high-fat diet (HFD) for 12 weeks. For in vitro experiments, AML-12 cells were treated with FFA mixture (OA:PA molar ratio = 2:1) to mimic lipid overload condition. MASH mice were administered beta-SIT (10 or 20 mg.kg(-1) d(-1), i.g.) for 10 weeks. We showed that beta-SIT treatment dose-dependently alleviated MASH by enhancing the lipophagy-lysosomal pathway in vivo and in vitro. In FFA-stimulated AML-12 cells, we demonstrated that beta-SIT (20 muM) activated autophagic flux, promoted lysosomal biogenesis, and enhanced lysosome-lipid droplet interactions, as revealed by transmission electron microscopy, multi-SIM real-time fluorescence monitoring, and lipophagy-related marker detection. By integrated approaches including bioinformatics, molecular dynamics, CETSA and functional assays, we found that beta-SIT inhibited mTOR pathway activation by directly targeting Ras-related C3 botulinum toxin substrate 1 (RAC1) in MASH mice. By conducting imaging/3D reconstruction, co-immunoprecipitation, immunofluorescence colocalization, lysosomal fractionation, and biochemical analyses in FFA-stimulated AML-12 cells, we confirmed that beta-SIT modulated RAC1/mTOR interactions on lysosomes to restore lipophagy function. Critically, beta-SIT promoted transcription factor EB (TFEB) nuclear translocation by modulating the RAC1-mTOR axis, thereby repairing lipophagy-lysosomal defects and attenuating MASH progression. Our results suggest that targeting the RAC1-mTOR-TFEB axis is a novel mechanism of beta-SIT-driven lipophagy-lysosomal regulation, and highlight beta-SIT as a potential candidate for the treatment of MASH.
abstract_zh: 代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝炎（MASH）是代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病（MAFLD）的一种炎症亚型，驱动肝功能紊乱并造成重大健康负担。脂噬功能障碍破坏脂滴降解并诱导溶酶体损伤，这与MASH进展密切相关；因此，靶向脂噬-溶酶体激活已成为治疗MASH的一种有前景的策略。源自水蓼（Polygonum hydropiper L.）的β-谷甾醇（beta-SIT）在结构上与胆固醇相似，并表现出神经保护、抗糖尿病和抗肥胖生物活性。在本研究中，我们探讨了beta-SIT对MASH的治疗潜力。通过喂食胆碱缺乏、L-氨基酸定义的高脂饮食（CDAHFD）10周，或高脂饮食（HFD）12周，建立了MASH小鼠模型。在体外实验中，AML-12细胞用游离脂肪酸混合物（OA:PA摩尔比 = 2:1）处理以模拟脂质过载条件。MASH小鼠接受beta-SIT（10或20 mg.kg(-1) d(-1)，灌胃）治疗10周。我们发现，beta-SIT治疗在体内和体外通过增强脂噬-溶酶体通路剂量依赖性地缓解了MASH。在FFA刺激的AML-12细胞中，我们证明beta-SIT（20 μM）激活了自噬流，促进了溶酶体生物发生，并增强了溶酶体-脂滴相互作用，这通过透射电子显微镜、多SIM实时荧光监测和脂噬相关标志物检测得以揭示。通过整合生物信息学、分子动力学（molecular dynamics）、CETSA和功能分析等方法，我们发现beta-SIT通过直接靶向Ras相关C3肉毒毒素底物1（RAC1）抑制了MASH小鼠中的mTOR通路激活。通过在FFA刺激的AML-12细胞中进行成像/三维重建、免疫共沉淀、免疫荧光共定位、溶酶体分级分离和生化分析，我们确认beta-SIT调节了溶酶体上的RAC1/mTOR相互作用以恢复脂噬功能。关键的是，beta-SIT通过调节RAC1-mTOR轴促进了转录因子EB（TFEB）核转位，从而修复脂噬-溶酶体缺陷并减缓MASH进展。我们的结果表明，靶向RAC1-mTOR-TFEB轴是beta-SIT驱动的脂噬-溶酶体调控的新机制，并强调beta-SIT作为治疗MASH的潜在候选药物。
